characters.name: Cain
characters.title: Master Mahan
characters.bio: Son of Adam and Eve who loved Satan more than God, covenanted with him in secret, and slew his brother Abel for gain. Cursed and shut out from the Lord's presence, he became the father of secret combinations.

characters.name: Abel
characters.title: The Faithful Shepherd
characters.bio: Son of Adam and Eve and a keeper of sheep who hearkened to the voice of the Lord. The Lord accepted his offering of the firstlings of his flock, and his envious brother Cain slew him in the field.

characters.name: Mahijah
characters.title: The Questioner
characters.bio: A man who came to Enoch as he preached and asked him plainly who he was and from whence he came. His question opened Enoch's account of his call and his vision of the Lord.

characters.name: Methuselah
characters.title: Son of Enoch
characters.bio: Son of Enoch, who was not taken up with Zion so that the Lord's covenant with Enoch might be fulfilled through his seed. He prophesied that all the kingdoms of the earth would spring from his loins and lived 969 years.

characters.name: Terah
characters.title: Father of Abraham
characters.bio: Abraham's father in Ur of the Chaldees, who turned to the idolatry of the heathen and consented to his son's sacrifice. Afflicted by famine, he repented for a time and journeyed with Abraham as far as Haran, where he returned to his idols.

characters.name: Lot
characters.title: Abraham's Nephew
characters.bio: Son of Abraham's brother Haran, who prayed with Abraham and journeyed with him from Ur through Haran into Canaan. He later settled toward Sodom and was delivered by angels before its destruction.
